source: Fixed-window planning policy; precision is measured after execution, not a planning target
precisionMeaning: 셀별 정밀도(CI)는 측정 후 기록하며 목표치가 아님
laneFirstPowerModesSource: power modes the E5 runs used (control-222 E5 result JSON); measured first so an interrupted campaign still covers E5
memoryMaxBatchSource: lattepanda Smol CPU b2 OOMKilled (exit 137) under the 0.8×allocatable limit 5.98Gi, b1 peak 5.78Gi (2026-11-01 05:49Z); other 8 GB boards have limits 5.3-6.1Gi; RTX 2080 Ti CUDA b4 fails at warmup (Softmax RUNTIME_EXCEPTION, 2026-11-01 13:14Z); orin-nano cuda-vlm fails at b1 the same way (canary 2026-11-01 18:36Z), 0 = whole combination unmeasurable; xavier Smol FP32 CPU b1 OOMKilled under 5.28Gi (2026-11-02 00:13Z)
declaredBatchConflictReason: artifact 선언 batch 집합의 부분 요청 불가

cpuSource.rule: largest whole core count a measurement Pod can get in that mode: min(Node allocatable, mode onlineCPUs) minus other Pods' requests, floored. Any nonzero other request (node-agent 15m, edgemesh-agent 500m, mosquitto 100m on edge nodes; 3.4 on genesis3) costs one whole core, so the edge maximum is online-1.
cpuSource.xavier2Core: E5 uses the xavier 2CORE modes, so those cells split request 1 / quota 2 (all online cores); the split rule applies to every cell from the next campaign (user, 2026-11-01)
cpuSource.orinNano: jetson-orin-nano-8g allocatable stays at the CPUs online when edgecore last registered (4 after 7W), so MAXN_SUPER requests of 5 fail CurvePlanResolution (2026-11-01 09:08Z); xavier and agx-orin keep full allocatable across modes
